classification.difficultyReason: The student reads a composite cross-section from the diagram, recognises that the 4 cm labels give the quadrant radius, and adds a rectangle to a quarter circle. The prism length is then applied and the result rounded. This takes a few routine linked steps with no unsignposted insight, and it is a little more than one-step area-and-volume work.

content.prompt: Calculate the volume of this composite solid. Round your answer to 1 d.p.
